review_topic: software architecture of entity resolution systems
additional_context: Apply these rules only to the title, abstract, and minimal bibliographic metadata.

inclusion_criteria.label: is er
inclusion_criteria.description: Is about entity resolution (or a derivative)

inclusion_criteria.label: most comprehensive
inclusion_criteria.description: Most comprehensive description of system according to authors

exclusion_criteria.label: not e2e
exclusion_criteria.description: Focused on a component of ER without mentioning the end-to-end ER process

exclusion_criteria.label: not generic er
exclusion_criteria.description: Does not describe ER, but an application of ER

exclusion_criteria.label: not system
exclusion_criteria.description: Describes a technique, method or experiment instead of a full-blown system

exclusion_criteria.label: secondary study
exclusion_criteria.description: Is a secondary study (review, mapping study, etc.)
